description: The user asks the agent to validate a time-series momentum signal on SPY with rigorous train/test methodology — from exploratory data analysis, through signal formalization and evaluation, to proper in-sample / out-of-sample separation and overfitting assessment.
user_opening: I need to validate a time-series momentum signal on SPY. I can handle the code, but I don't understand the financial logic behind it. What should this do and why?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: User performs exploratory analysis, formalizes a momentum signal, evaluates it with IC/quantile metrics, implements a proper train/test split backtest, reports separate IS and OOS metrics, and discusses robustness and overfitting.
required_capabilities: Perform exploratory data analysis on market data
Evaluate signal quality with IC or quantile analysis
Report separate in-sample and out-of-sample metrics
ground_truth.termination_criteria: The agent has completed the following steps with computational evidence (not just verbal discussion): (1) Showed code and output for exploratory data analysis and a formalized momentum signal definition with computed values. (2) Showed code and output for a train/test split backtest that reports in-sample and out-of-sample metrics separately. (3) Discussed overfitting risk or signal robustness using concrete evidence from the IS vs OOS comparison. (4) Responded to the user's follow-up with additional validation analysis or robustness discussion. Once all four steps have been computationally demonstrated, the session is complete.
